verdict.rationale: BugSnag publishes its Data Access API as an OpenAPI 3.0.3 document on SwaggerHub. Its developer portal has a reference generated from that spec, with Authentication, Pagination, Rate Limiting and Versioning pages, so a structured API reference exists. The evidence does not show that the reference is interactive (try-it-out console) or that it includes runnable examples. missing for 10: documented interactive try-it console, runnable request/response examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of interactivity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
